# `blackbird-client` rubygem

This rubygem is mainly a client wrapper for the twirp APIs so the monolith and other ruby services can easily integrate with Blackbird.

## Source

The source for the rubygem lives in the [`/ruby/lib`](../ruby/lib) directory in this repository. Right now, the code is all autogenerated.

## Adding twirp services/endpoints

When you add the protobuf definitions for new twirp endpoints/services in [`/proto/`](../proto/), you must run `./script/protoc` to generate updated go and ruby client code.

Once you've done this you should see new code in the [`/ruby/lib`](../ruby/lib) directory.

You should also increase the version number in ['/ruby/lib/version.rb`](../ruby/lib/version.rb).

## Updating the rubygem in the monolith

The dotcom Gemfile uses [Bundler's git support](https://bundler.io/guides/git.html) for managing internal Gems.

To update the version of the `blackbird-client` gem used in dotcom, identify the `blackbird-client` gem entry in the Gemfile, and update the git `ref` to an appropriate commit OID.

Run `script/bootstrap` to bundle and vendor the gem. Verify the intended git ref was used to build the gem. Then run `bin/tapioca gem` and `bin/rails db:migrate db:test:soft_reset; bin/tapioca dsl` to update the corresponding Sorbet rbi and dsl files.
Once satisfied, commit the changes and follow the standard PR process in `github/github`.
